system.description: When initiative is rolled, you may attempt a small stunt instead of rolling. Test Agility (DR14). Triumph: you act before every foe, and your first attack this encounter has Boon. Success: you act before every foe. Failure: you act after every foe. Ruin: as Failure, and you start the fight Prone. Whatever the result, you have Adrenaline on your first turn.
